title: 第194章 准帝雷劫第193章 叶梵的血泪史
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
九幽仙城！
当下，左丘辰与慕容仙儿并肩走出本源塔的那一刻，整座九幽仙城的天地灵气都为之震颤。
嗡嗡嗡！
与此同时，五色法则光芒在他周身流转不息。
只见，玄黄居中如大地般厚重深沉！
冰蓝在左似万古寒冰般凛冽！
赤金在右如烈日熔岩般暴烈！
金黄在前若天剑横空般锋锐！
青绿在后似春风化雨般绵长！
此刻，五色光芒以玄黄母气为核心，按照五行相生的顺序缓缓旋转，形成了一个完美无缺的法则闭环...
金生水，水生木，木生火，火生土，土生金！
五行相生的奥义在他体内自动运转，每一次循环都让他周身的法则波动更加圆融一分。
而五行相克的约束之力则如同五道无形的枷锁...
故此，将五行法则的狂暴一面牢牢锁住，使其既能爆发出毁天灭地的威能，又不会失控反噬己身！
“五行至臻，齐聚！”
顿时，左丘辰抬起右手，五指虚张。
呼呼呼！
刹那间，金木水火土五色法则在指尖凝聚，化作五颗拳头大小的法则光球，滴溜溜旋转着。
而光球之间以肉眼可见的法则丝线相连，形成了一个微型的五行法阵。
仔细看去，法阵中央，一滴玄黄母气凝成的金色液体悬浮着，如同整个五行体系的定海神针...

慕容仙儿站在他身旁，她的气息同样发生了翻天覆地的变化。
因为，日月同辉经的共享之力让她也同步达到了五行至臻的境界。
不过与左丘辰不同的是，她的五行法则中多了一缕无情道剑的锋锐之意。
而那是她自身的道韵与五行法则融合后的独特印记...
“感觉如何？”
当下，慕容仙儿偏头看向左丘辰，白裙在五色光芒的映照下泛着梦幻般的光泽。
“前所未有的好！”
顿时，左丘辰握了握拳头，感受着体内澎湃到几乎要溢出来的法则之力。
“五行齐聚之后，五行术的最后一个瓶颈也打通了。”
“现在我体内的法则之力比之前浑厚了至少五倍，而且五行相生让法则恢复速度也提升了数倍。”
“如此，就算连续激战三天三夜，法则之力也不会枯竭！”
他说着，忽然眉头一挑，抬头望向天际。
轰隆隆！
只见九幽仙城上空，原本晴朗的天空忽然暗了下来。
那不是乌云遮日的那种暗，而是整个天穹都在以一种诡异的频率震颤着。
那感觉，就像是有什么庞然大物正在从天外降临，挤压得这片天地的法则都开始扭曲变形....
“雷劫！”
“准帝雷劫！”
此刻，慕容仙儿也察觉到了，她的瞳孔中倒映出一丝紫金色的雷光。
“五行至臻引发的准帝雷劫，来了。”

话音未落，天空中炸开一道惊天动地的雷鸣。
轰隆隆！
那雷声不是寻常雷暴那种炸响后便消散的动静，而是如同万钟齐鸣般连绵不绝，一波接一波地在天穹中回荡。
content_en:
Nine Nether Fairy City!
The moment Zuo Qiuchen and Murong Xian'er walked out of the Origin Tower side by side, the entire Jiuyou Immortal City's spiritual energy trembled.
Buzz!
At the same time, the five-color law light circulated around him endlessly.
I saw that Xuanhuang was as thick and deep as the earth in the middle!
The ice blue on the left is as cold as eternal ice!
The red gold on the right is as violent as the scorching sun and lava!
The golden one in front is as sharp as a sword in the sky!
The greenery behind is as long as the spring breeze and rain!
At this moment, the five-color light, with the black and yellow mother energy as the core, slowly rotates in accordance with the order of the five elements, forming a perfect closed loop of laws...
Metal generates water, water generates wood, wood generates fire, fire generates earth, and earth generates metal!
The secret of the interdependence of the five elements circulates automatically in his body, and each cycle makes the fluctuations of the laws around him more harmonious.
The restraining power of the five elements is like five invisible shackles...
Therefore, the violent side of the Five Elements Law is firmly locked, so that it can explode with power that destroys the heaven and earth, but will not lose control and backfire on oneself!
"The five elements are perfect, gathered together!"
Suddenly, Zuo Qiuchen raised his right hand and bluffed his fingers.
Hoo ho ho!
In an instant, the five-color laws of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth condensed at the fingertips, turning into five fist-sized balls of law light, spinning smoothly.
The light balls are connected with regular threads visible to the naked eye, forming a miniature five-element array.
Looking carefully, in the center of the array, a drop of golden liquid condensed from black and yellow mother energy is suspended, like the Dinghai Shenzhen of the entire Five Elements system...
Murong Xian'er stood beside him, her aura also undergoing earth-shaking changes.
Because the shared power of the Sun and the Moon and the Hui Sutra allowed her to reach the perfection of the five elements at the same time.
However, unlike Zuo Qiuchen, her Five Elements Law has a hint of the sharpness of the ruthless Taoist sword.
And that is the unique imprint of the fusion of her own Taoist charm and the Five Elements Law...
"How does it feel?"
At that moment, Murong Xianer turned her head to look at Zuo Qiuchen, her white dress glowing with a dreamlike luster under the five-color light.
“Better than ever!”
Suddenly, Zuo Qiuchen clenched his fists, feeling the power of law surge inside his body to the point of almost overflowing.
"After the five elements come together, the last bottleneck of the Five Elements Technique has been overcome."
"Now the power of law in my body is at least five times stronger than before, and the interaction of the five elements has increased the recovery speed of the law several times."
"In this way, even if we fight fiercely for three days and three nights, the power of the law will not be exhausted!"
As he spoke, he suddenly raised his eyebrows and looked up at the sky.
Boom!
I saw that the originally clear sky above Jiuyou Fairy City suddenly darkened.
It was not the kind of darkness where dark clouds cover the sun, but the entire sky was trembling with a strange frequency.
It felt like something huge was coming from the sky, squeezing the laws of the world and starting to distort...
"Thunder Tribulation!"
"Quasi-Emperor Thunder Tribulation!"
At this moment, Murong Xianer also noticed that a trace of purple-gold lightning was reflected in her pupils.
"The Quasi-Emperor Thunder Tribulation caused by the Perfection of Five Elements is here."
Before he finished speaking, an earth-shattering thunder exploded in the sky.
Boom!
The thunder was not the kind of sound that usually explodes and then dissipates in an ordinary thunderstorm, but was continuous like the tolling of thousands of bells, echoing in the sky one after another.
